newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end up, led by power stocks.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end up, led by power stocks.

text.p: Brazilian stocks rose on Tuesday, led by surges in power sector stocks, despite a decline in benchmark Telebras amid rising volatility ahead of next Monday's options expiry, brokers said.
"There was a lot of volatility today with options settlement coming up," a local trader said.
The Sao Paulo bolsa's Bovespa index of 48 most-traded shares ended up 0.29 percent at 11,429 points on volume totalling 965.8 million reais ($898.4 million).
